# Feature Readiness Checklist: Formas de Pagamento

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity and consistency of the Spec 004 requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all professor-provided fields for Forma de Pagamento and Item da Forma de Pagamento documented without additional business fields? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK002 Are create, list, view, edit and delete requirements documented with observable outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK003 Are backend validation, visible errors, preserved input and protection against partial persistence specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006–FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is pagination explicitly quantified as ten records per page? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]

## Clarification Quality

- [x] CHK005 Is `dia` unambiguously defined as the integer number of days after the purchase or sale date? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is the one-item-per-parcel relationship stated consistently in the clarification, requirements and data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §Invariantes]
- [x] CHK007 Is the exact 100% total stated consistently in the clarification, requirements and data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §Invariantes]
- [x] CHK008 Are all former clarification markers resolved without contradictory alternatives remaining? [Ambiguity, Spec §Clarifications]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK009 Are primary-flow acceptance scenarios independently testable for create, consult, update and delete? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [x] CHK010 Are invalid-data outcomes measurable in terms of rejection, error feedback, input preservation and no partial data? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK011 Are success criteria technology-agnostic and objectively verifiable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §Success Criteria]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are empty-list, invalid submission, divergent item count and invalid percentage-total scenarios addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Quickstart §Cenários 2–3]
- [x] CHK013 Are atomic update and dependent-item deletion expectations documented? [Recovery, Data Model §Transições]
- [x] CHK014 Is unauthenticated access behavior covered while avoiding implementation of authentication in this feature? [Dependency, Spec §FR-013, Quickstart §Cenário 7]

## Scope and Constitution Consistency

- [x] CHK015 Is the feature explicitly bounded away from Specs 008, 012 and all other purchase, sale, stock and financial features? [Scope, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK016 Are the required Laravel stack, SQLite, MVC, Eloquent, migrations, Form Requests, Blade, Bootstrap and PHPUnit decisions documented consistently? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK017 Does the plan avoid Laravel Boost, PostgreSQL, unnecessary APIs, Repository Pattern and speculative architecture? [Constraint, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK018 Does the Constitution Check cover requirements priority, persistence, validation, pagination, testing, Portuguese domain and authentication dependency? [Traceability, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
